即使……也…….english: Even if the stated condition is true, the result still applies.

正是…….english: Precisely or exactly; emphasizes the identity of someone or something.

越……越…….english: The more one condition changes, the more another changes.

一旦……就…….english: Once a condition occurs, the following result follows.

无论……都…….english: No matter which condition holds, the result is unchanged.

一边……一边…….english: Two actions happen simultaneously: doing A while doing B.

连……都…….english: Even an unexpected or extreme example meets the stated result.

只要……便…….english: As long as a condition holds, the result follows; 便 is a literary form of 就.

再……也…….english: Even if something happens again or to a greater degree, the following outcome still holds.

虽然……却…….english: Although one fact holds, a contrasting fact follows; 却 highlights the contrast.

虽然……但是…….english: Although one fact holds, a contrasting fact follows.

虽然……可是…….english: Although one fact holds, a contrasting fact follows; 可是 is conversational.

不得不…….english: Expresses necessity or compulsion: cannot avoid doing something.

被…….english: Passive construction: the subject experiences an action done by someone or something.

毕竟…….english: After all; introduces a fact offered as a reason or qualification.

越来越…….english: An ongoing change that becomes increasingly pronounced.

反而…….english: Instead or on the contrary, often contrary to what was expected.

不是……而是…….english: Contrasts an incorrect explanation with the actual one: not A, but B.

只要……就…….english: As long as the stated condition holds, the result follows.

不但……而且…….english: Not only one fact but also an additional one.

如果……那…….english: If a condition holds, then the stated consequence follows; 那 introduces the result.

将…….english: Formal or literary object-fronting construction, similar to 把.

把……给…….english: Disposal/conveyance construction: transfer the object to someone.

把……换…….english: Disposal construction: take the named object and exchange or change it.

……比……多.english: Comparative construction meaning more than the other item.

……一下.english: A short action or polite softener, often expressing trying something briefly.

……却…….english: A contrastive adverb: yet, however, or unexpectedly instead.

在…….english: Marks location or an ongoing action, according to the following phrase.

没有人…….english: Existential negation meaning nobody is doing or has the stated property.
